description: This file defines an interface and a class for a simple Orleans grain used in testing. The grain allows setting two integers, incrementing one, and retrieving their product or value.

classes.name: SimpleGrain
classes.description: A simple Orleans grain that manages two integer properties and provides methods to set, increment, and multiply them.

methods.name: SetA
methods.description: Sets the value of property A.

methods.name: SetB
methods.description: Sets the value of property B.

methods.name: IncrementA
methods.description: Increments the value of property A by one.

methods.name: GetAxB
methods.description: Returns the product of A and B.

methods.name: GetAxB (overload)
methods.description: Returns the product of provided arguments a and b.

methods.name: GetA
methods.description: Returns the current value of A.
